text:
adele: quick check — need to lock owners for the console obs milestones (dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, retention). Who is driving retention work and the rollout plan?

sam: i can take retention config for dashboards + metric expiry policy. will need an owner for trace ingestion changes (sampling + storage) tho.

noah: i can own trace ingestion changes. plan is: change sampler -> small canary -> ramp 24h -> roll. need a list of dashboards that expect full traces so we can identify brittle queries.

adele: perfect — @noah owns trace ingestion. @sam owns dashboard retention. @tess or @liz can you confirm error-analysis views ownership?

liz: i can take error-analysis views (aggregations + alerting). will need a short list of fields we rely on from traces/metrics (span.id, service, env, error_type).

tess: can help with the dashboards that power SRE alerts — will sync with @sam and add myself to the ownership matrix.

adele: dependencies to call out: infra needs a config flag for trace TTLs (will be a runtime toggle), platform needs a migration plan for old traces, and product wants a rollback story if alerts spike.

noah: infra ask: can we get the TTL flag in staging by EOD Wed? i can prepare the canary job once it's there.

sam: timeline looks like: TTL flag in staging Wed, retention rules live in config Thu, canary Fri, full ramp Mon. if any blockers we push.

adele: major risk: some legacy dashboards currently query raw trace tables — @tess please create a list so we can mark them as excluded or rewrite to aggregated tables.

ops-bot: deploy-plan: trace-ttl-flag -> deploy to staging -> tag canary-job -> wait for green. (automated note)

liz: i'll start drafting the error-analysis PR with the required fields. tagging owners in the checklist.

tess: i'll post the dashboard list by EOD today and start PRs for rewrites next week.

sam: small code-review ask: retention rule schema change is in my branch — ping @adele and @noah for quick review when it's up.

adele: will review. also can we add a short rollback playbook to the runbook before canary? one pager with steps and who to call.

noah: agreed — i'll draft rollback steps and include the trace-query to revert sampler config.

adele: awesome. owners confirmed: retention -> sam, trace ingestion -> noah, error-analysis -> liz, SRE dashboard rewrite -> tess. next check-in Friday 10am. thanks all :thumbsup:
